source.title: Forebears Gambia forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Localized name pool refreshed against public frequency tables. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry.

source.title: ITU Gambia national numbering plan communication of 26.XI.2019

phones.notes: ITU/PURA confirms country code +220 and seven-digit national numbers, with public/mobile/fixed allocations beginning with these first digits. Generated numbers are synthetic and not checked for live assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms Gambian address examples with street and locality lines but no public postcode grammar. postalPrefixes remain synthetic product placeholders for stable test data generation.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Gambia ordinary passport document entry

passport.notes: PRADO confirms the Gambian ordinary passport document family, but the public entry reviewed does not confirm the visible passport number grammar. The PC plus seven digits template remains a synthetic placeholder.

national_identification_number.label: National Identification Number
national_identification_number.notes: The public national digital identity strategy confirms an 11-digit NIN on the biometric ID card and describes the leading date-of-birth component. Generation intentionally uses a random 11-digit template because the public source did not provide enough implementation detail for a safe date-order/checksum or allocation rule.
